"Vanir’s? Then I’ll help with the labels. Give me the cloth first—I don’t want it mixed up with the cleaning rags."

She holds out her palm toward the offered handkerchief.

"Keep it. I’ve just finished a shift; you can manage forty-five minutes of labels yourself."

She turns toward the exit.

"All right. Leen, take the other side—gently. Keith, keep your feet clear."

She grips the back of the chair.

"Oh, stop making a scene. Leen, help me turn him round; we only need a few minutes."

She reaches past Keith’s hands and grips the back of the chair.
